svg.title: The fine city problem: placing surveillance cameras to catch litterbugs
svg.desc: A stylised top-down view of a Singapore neighbourhood block with a park, residential blocks, a hawker centre and a void deck, divided by two roads. Red smudges mark litter hotspots. Three camera domes are mounted with blue cones showing their coverage, catching most but not all of the hotspots. A fourth candidate site near the residential blocks is drawn as a dashed outline and rejected, with a speech bubble reading complaints, leaving a nearby hotspot uncovered.
